{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gallaze''' was an herbivorous [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the swamplands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]]. They resembled small [[Deer/Legends|deer]] and moved in herds of twelve to twenty individuals. Of the few [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who had the privilege of visiting Trinta, many discovered that Gallaze were an excellent food source.
